title: conditions
description: C6 radiation source data for one zone. The containing bundle or API response identifies the zone. Routing owns dose integration and the Forbush duration rule.

sol.description: Optional source mission sol; never a replacement for UTC.

value.description: Finite positive source dose rate, compatible with C4 Conditions.

uncertainty.description: Nonnegative relative uncertainty: 0.2 means plus or minus 20 percent. Its percentage must fit a finite double.

utc_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC with up to seven fractional digits, compatible with C4 DateTime precision. Z and +00:00 are accepted.

type.description: A free DONKI activity type or SEP; not a closed enumeration.

modifier.description: Applies in [valid_from, valid_to). The contract validator and consumers must check valid_from < valid_to.
